title: Muslim Pro: Quran Athan Prayer
description:
Your Ultimate Quran, Prayer, and Islamic Resource

Enhance your daily deen with Muslim Pro – the most comprehensive digital resource for all your Islamic needs. Access verified prayer times, the complete Holy Quran, precise Azan notifications (also known as Athan or Adhan), accurate Qibla direction, and much more to deepen your Islam. Join millions of Muslims worldwide in strengthening your connection to Allah through Islam.

Key Features to Elevate Your Worship in Islam:

Verified Prayer Times & Azan: Receive accurate, location-based prayer times verified by trusted sources. Customize your Azan notifications (also Athan and Adhan) to ensure you never miss a prayer, making your daily worship seamless.

Holy Quran: Explore the full Holy Quran with audio recitations, multiple translations, and powerful tools for memorization and reflection. Delve deeper into the teachings of Islam with the Holy Quran.

Qibla Finder: Easily locate the Qibla direction toward Mecca for your prayers, wherever you are. Our accurate Qibla finder ensures your Qibla is always precise for every prayer.

Daily Duas & Dhikr: Complete your daily worship with a digital Tasbih and a library of essential supplications for every Muslim on their journey in Islam.

Muslim Content on Qalbox: Stream Muslim-friendly films, TV shows, and kids' content that align with your Islamic values.

Halal Restaurant Finder: Locate nearby Halal restaurants in your neighborhood with ease, supporting your Islamic lifestyle.

Mosque Finder: Find mosques near you to prayer, attend events, and connect with your local Muslim community, fostering the spirit of Islam.

Live Classes: Learn about the Quran, Arabic, and more through weekly Islamic sessions, enriching your knowledge of Islam.

Umrah by Muslim Pro: Plan your Umrah journey with peace of mind using our secure and trusted booking service, an important act of worship in Islam.

Unlock the Full Muslim Pro Experience with Premium:

Offline Quran Reading and Listening: Download the Holy Quran and listen to audio recitations anytime, even without internet access, enhancing your Islamic learning.

An ad-free interface and enhanced features designed to elevate your practice of Islam.

Supported Languages:
Enjoy the resource and its features in multiple languages, including English, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu, Français, العربية, اردو, and more, making Islam accessible globally.

Pro Tips for Optimal Use:

Keep the resource updated for the most accurate verified prayer times and Quran features, ensuring your best Islamic experience.

Enable auto-location to adjust prayer notifications based on your area, for timely Azan alerts.

Open the resource daily to ensure seamless access to verified prayer times, Qibla tools for Mecca, mosque finder, and Halal restaurant finder, all vital for daily Islamic life.

Stay Connected:
Website: muslimpro.com
Instagram: @MuslimProOfficial
TikTok: @MuslimProOfficial
YouTube: MuslimProApp
Facebook: MuslimPro
Twitter: @MuslimPro

Discover Muslim Pro – your trusted resource for verified prayer times, Quran, Azan (Athan/Adhan), Qibla toward Mecca, Halal, and so much more. Perfect your worship and embrace your deen with ease, living a life guided by Islam.
